author: Kusha N M
raw:
ದುರ್ದಿನವು ದಿನಪನನು ಮೇಘಮುತ್ತಿರಲಾಗಿ
ಮರ್ದಿಸುವ ರವಿದಿನವು ಕತ್ತಲೆಯ ಜಗವ
ವರ್ಧಿಸುತ ಚೈತನ್ಯ ತಮನಿಶೆಯ ಕಳೆಯುತಲೆ
ಸ್ಪರ್ಧಿಪೆ ಜಗದೊಡನೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: On a bad day, clouds besiege the sun;
but the day of the sun crushes the world’s darkness;
growing in vigour, dispelling the night of darkness,
you will compete with the world, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Even the sun is sometimes hidden by clouds, yet its light always returns to drive out darkness. Renew your energy, shake off gloom, and hold your own in the world.
